extensionAttribute.description: Returns the installed FortiClient version from the fctinfo config file, or 0 if absent.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # FortiClient Version Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
info="/Library/Application Support/Fortinet/FortiClient/conf/fctinfo"
if [[ -f "$info" ]]; then version=$(/usr/bin/awk -F'=' '/^version=/ { print $2; exit }' "$info") [[ -z "$version" ]] && version=$(/usr/bin/cut -d'=' -f2 "$info" | /usr/bin/head -n1) echo "<result>${version:-0}</result>" else echo "<result>0</result>" fi
